explanation:
I and II are correct statements.

"The pitch of a note depends on its amplitude" is false, so III must be excluded.

The answer is I and II only.

text: Which of the following statements about sound waves are correct? I. Sound is a transverse wave II. An echo is produced by the reflection of sound III. Sound is a longitudinal wave
explanation:
II and III are correct statements.

"Sound is a transverse wave" is false, so I must be excluded.

The answer is II and III only.

text: Which of the following statements about sound waves is correct? I. Sound travels faster than light II. Sound is a transverse wave III. Sound is a longitudinal wave
explanation:
Sound is a longitudinal wave — this is correct.

The other two statements are not true: "Sound travels faster than light" and "Sound is a transverse wave" both misstate the physics.

So only III is correct.
